entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Lausanne–Bercher line is a metre gauge railway line in the canton of Vaud in Switzerland. The line connects the city of Lausanne with Bercher via Echallens. It is owned and operated by the Chemin de fer Lausanne-Échallens-Bercher (LEB). It is under the operational management of Transports publics de la région lausannoise.
